recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not change udiCarrier.deviceIdentifier back to Identifier or add redundant guidance under this DSTU1 issue; follow a new final OO/terminology decision if the unresolved THO/NamingSystem concerns are approved later.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification OO issue from the DSTU1 ballot objecting that Device.udi:string did not identify the UDI repository or jurisdiction and directing a move toward a system/repository-capable UDI representation under the udiCarrier name.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 22debf21aa4d990db2d0d76b70d03098cd30c040, whose subject states that it changed device.udi to device.udiCarrier and made the type Identifier to allow repository identification for #7254. Later Device UDI modeling changed the obsolete DSTU-era Identifier shape into the current udiCarrier backbone.
additional_context: Device is active in the current build. Current source defines Device.udiCarrier as a backbone with deviceIdentifier, deviceIdentifierSystem, issuer, jurisdiction, carrierHRF/carrierAIDC, and entryType. Related FHIR-11106, FHIR-32553, and FHIR-43063 have already been reconciled on the combined branch and support the current separated-field model; FHIR-51533 remains Waiting for Input and does not supply a final reversal.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build already satisfies the semantic intent of FHIR-7254 by avoiding a bare UDI string and by explicitly representing jurisdiction/repository authority and issuing/identifier systems.

related_jiras.note: Published DSTU2 issue asks the same jurisdiction/repository question for Device.udiCarrier and is already represented on the combined branch by ef24c9ea8c6cc938e962e593023af82d975e955f.
Published R4 issue refined Device.udiCarrier issuer and jurisdiction URI examples and is already represented on the combined branch.
Applied R6 issue considered Identifier-style modeling but chose the less disruptive deviceIdentifierSystem field, now present in current source and already represented on the combined branch.
Waiting for Input issue about UDI URI values not being defined in THO; it is not final enough to drive this reconciliation.
